advancements.assortedmobs.root.title: Assorted Mobs
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.bo:
A Bob-omb you put down follows you, and when a monster hurts you it will walk up to it and light its fuse. Be careful when hitting one yourself as its fuse will light.

One will ride on your head too. Sneak and use one with an empty hand to pick it back up.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.pa: Parabuzzies hover more than they fall. A fish may tame one.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.pe:
Use a tamed parabuzzy and it climbs onto your head. There it can slowly heal, and you will drift down as gently as it does and take no fall damage.

Sneak on the ground to put it down.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.ice_pixie.fi:
Nothing hurts an ice pixie unless you are holding a torch or flint and steel when you hit it.

Torches placed nearby burn it too.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.ice_pixie.in: Ice pixies live in snowy places and come out by day as well as by night. They throw ice at any player they see, and move faster on ice and snow.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.sea_creature: Found in cold and frozen seas, where now and then one comes up and stands its tusk out of the water. Two horns and a stick make a sword as good as stone.

Floats on its back in rivers and along milder coasts, dives to get about, and comes ashore now and then. Afloat it cracks open sea shells and leaves one behind every so often: they make a shovel, and armour as good as chainmail. Feed one a fish and it stays.

Both haul out on the ice and snow, never far from the water, and slip into it when they tire of the shore. They are a good deal quicker there. Both follow a fish and breed for one. A seal harms nothing, and bolts for the sea if it is hit.

A walrus is as peaceful until one is hit. Then every walrus in earshot charges, a good deal faster than it looks.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.treasure_mob: Now and then a chest walks off on its own. It carries whatever it found, anything from bread to diamonds.

A wild one keeps away from players, but gold nuggets lure it in. Feed it nuggets and it may decide to stay.

A tamed Treasure Mob follows you and sits when told to. Sneak and use it to open it as a chest.
manual.assortedmobs.description: The ice pixie, the treasure mob, the two 8-bit creatures, and the sea creatures.
